decision: Current hosted speaker pipeline and source-archive installation evidence verified within the declared scope; no material defect found.

speaker.source_scope: GitHub job/artifact metadata and embedded head/plan identify exact 11e; all 21 planned source hashes and 8 recorded worker source hashes match the inspected source bytes. No Git command was used.
speaker.actual_pipeline: One actual upload and one complete Small transcribe with word_timestamps=false, VAD false, beam 5, previous-text false, full default fallback and no hints. Native constructor cpu_threads=0/one worker/CPU/int8_float32 matches the unchanged app. Same engine completes recognition then 2 fixed-text encode+align calls on original tokens/windows and full waveform.
speaker.timing_and_text: All 8 timing segments retain exact authoritative recognized text; both native monotone paths, token probabilities and frame/window bindings are consistent. All 8 have real word evidence; no timing fallback warning. No new word-timing accuracy or recognition-correctness claim is made.
speaker.persistence: Exact 21-group record and warnings agree across saved report, independent immutable read-only SQLite reload, fresh-process reload, JSON/TXT/SRT/VTT, transcript ZIP member contents and schema-v2 library backup. All timed endpoints stay inward and within physical 34.635-second audio.
speaker.lifetime: Actual weak-reference/cache evidence shows recognizer released before speakers. No translation or summary was requested, so an actual subsequent text-AI transition is outside this run.
speaker.cpu_scope: Successful source-enforced 4-CPU launch affinity plus OMP/MKL 4; constructor 0 is a native-default request. Effective thread count and in-worker affinity readback are not claimed.
speaker.quality_scope: One already-exposed constructed English reading fixture. Same acoustic counts as f2 were independently recomputed from 11e raw turns; text/group counts were reviewed as new 11e outputs. General Greek, meeting, overlap, ASR meaning and precise word timing remain unapproved.

install.observed_install: Hosted fresh extraction ran actual start_linux.sh/new venv, installed curl-cffi 0.17.0 from standard requirements, returned 200 from health/diagnostics/homepage/library, passed pip check and shut down cleanly.
install.provenance_scope: Source ZIP commit/repository/SHA/Git-comment/path/member/module checks are recorded by the actual hosted verifier. The reviewer independently verified the installation evidence ZIP/log and GitHub metadata, and did not redownload or rehash the 42 MB source artifact. Outer artifact ZIP and inner candidate ZIP identities are distinct.
install.scope_limit: Fresh Linux Python 3.11 source install and startup only; no standalone installer, Windows/macOS install or model inference approval.

reviewer_preparation_note: One reviewer-only audit variable collided with a backup-manifest variable and raised KeyError before final reporting. Exact initial script and correction note are retained. Corrected stdlib audit passed 240 checks; no original artifact bytes or hosted gate were changed.
